## DropdownMenu.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `open` :: Whether the menu is open. Bind it, or let the trigger drive it.
- `onOpenChange` :: Called whenever the menu opens or closes.
- `placement` :: Where the menu sits relative to the trigger.
- `surface` :: The menu fill: frosted glass, or opaque.
- `trigger` :: The button that opens the menu. Spread `props` onto your own button.
- `children` :: The items, labels, separators and submenus.

## MenuCheckboxItem.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `checked` :: Whether the item is checked.
- `onCheckedChange` :: Called when the item is toggled.
- `shortcut` :: A keyboard shortcut, shown at the trailing edge.
- `size` :: The height of the check slot, so labels line up with the other items.
- `childTextSize` :: Text scale of the shortcut hint.
- `childTextColor` :: Ink of the shortcut hint.
- `disabled` :: Disables the item.
- `children` :: The option's text, drawn between the tick mark and the shortcut.

## MenuItem.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `icon` :: An icon drawn before the label.
- `shortcut` :: A keyboard shortcut, shown at the trailing edge.
- `disabled` :: Disables the item.
- `inset` :: Indent the label to line up with items that have an icon.
- `size` :: The height of the icon slot, so labels line up whether an item has an icon or not.
- `textColor` :: Ink of the item's icon.
- `childTextSize` :: Text scale of the shortcut hint.
- `childTextColor` :: Ink of the shortcut hint.
- `href` :: Renders the item as a link. The menu closes after it is followed.
- `onclick` :: Called when the item is chosen. The menu then closes, unless the event is cancelled.
- `children` :: The command's text, drawn after the icon and before the shortcut.

## MenuLabel.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `children` :: The label text.
- `textSize` :: Text scale of the heading.
- `textColor` :: Ink of the heading.

## MenuRadioGroup.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `value` :: The selected item's value.
- `onValueChange` :: Called when a radio item is chosen.
- `children` :: The radio items.

## MenuRadioItem.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `value` :: The value this item represents.
- `shortcut` :: A keyboard shortcut, shown at the trailing edge.
- `size` :: The height of the radio slot, so labels line up with the other items.
- `childTextSize` :: Text scale of the shortcut hint.
- `childTextColor` :: Ink of the shortcut hint.
- `disabled` :: Disables the item.
- `children` :: The option's text, drawn between the radio mark and the shortcut.

## MenuSub.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `open` :: Whether the submenu is open. Bind it, or let hover and arrow keys drive it.
- `onOpenChange` :: Called whenever the submenu opens or closes.
- `icon` :: An icon drawn before the label.
- `label` :: The row's label.
- `disabled` :: Disables the submenu trigger.
- `surface` :: The submenu fill: frosted glass, or opaque.
- `textColor` :: Ink of the submenu's own icon.
- `childTextColor` :: Ink of the chevron that opens the submenu.
- `children` :: The items of the submenu.

## menu.ts

### `interface MenuContext`

Shared state between a menu and its items.

- `uid` :: The menu's unique id prefix.
- `close` :: Closes the root menu.

### `interface MenuRadioContext`

Shared state between a radio group and its items.

- `value` :: The selected value.
- `setValue` :: Selects a value and closes the root menu.

### `const menuRoving`

Roving selector for one menu level — skips items inside nested popovers.
